plain: This story is about Haim Eshed, an Israeli official described as the head of Israel's version of a space force, and what he is said to have claimed around 2020. A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that Eshed wrote an autobiography in which he talks about a Galactic Federation, an alliance of beings from beyond Earth, and the story's setting runs from Israel to Mars. On another episode Michels says Eshed also spoke about a secret space programme along with other unusual things about UFOs. A UFO researcher named James Fox, speaking with Michels, does not name Eshed or the Federation but stresses that the position of head of Israel's space force equivalent is an extremely important one. Michels tells it several times across his podcast, while Fox adds only the weight of the job. People tell it because, if true, a senior defence official would be saying openly that humans are in contact with an organised group of non-human beings.
